purpose: Planning inspection artifact; does not change curated eligibility or certify fit/motion. Original-source boards must be distinguished from extracted/generated artifacts.

items.title: Steerable Technic front axle; the pinion lives in the parent
items.lesson: A steerable, sprung Technic front axle carries the steering rack, but the 8T pinion that drives the rack is placed in the parent frame.
items.description: A steerable, sprung front axle with a steering rack and links. It lacks the pinion, which the parent places.

Source step 11: rack housing and both steering links added

findings: Front suspension arms, shock and steering links are visible; parent frame supplies the pinion. Keep lesson and parent dependency together; no claim of complete steering mechanism in isolated axle.

items.title: Differential rear axle with U-joints, mounted tilted

Source step 5: hub frames and outgoing half-shafts added on both sides

findings: Differential, U-joint input, half-shafts and leaning shock match source lesson and mounted rear location. Keep repair/source-study status because known raw shock geometry errors are not disproved by clean rendering.

items.title: V8 engine: crank train hidden under the cylinder banks

findings: Two cylinder banks and hidden crank are visible in step and transparent views; source role at drag-racer front matches. Static illustration does not establish working motion.

items.title: Slave I cockpit pod on a revolute pivot

findings: Pilot pod, fixed Technic bearing bricks and marked axis are visually consistent. Posed copy demonstrates intended relative transform, not dome clearance or passive self-leveling.
Additional three-pose board opened: bearings fixed across 0/45/90 degrees. Synthetic pose does not establish full-parent clearance.
